يستعجل (form X)
# يَسْتَعْجِلُ (yastaʕjilu) /jas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# يُسْتَعْجَلُ (yustaʕjalu) /jus.taʕ.d͡ʒa.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# يَسْتَعْجِلَ (yastaʕjila) /jas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
